prompt:
[curious] My Mothership is a Legendary. Two thousand one hundred health... and swords can't even touch it.

[matter-of-fact] So I sent two Star Fighters after it.

[amused, a little surprised] It didn't last long.

[slightly worried] And both fighters flew home without a scratch.

[genuinely asking] So... is my Legendary too weak in the air? Or are the fighters too strong?
